claims.text: POL-NS-04 limb (c) is satisfied on clean telemetry. EV-GPS-00204 carries a rider track of 105 fixes and every one of them is a qualifying fix, with the rider's device never more than 39.94 m from the pickup pin (mean 21.08 m) — far inside the 150 m rider_presence_radius_m that fee_schedule sets for LARGE_VENUE. The rider was at the pickup point for the whole waiting window, not merely at some point within it, so the majority-of-qualifying-fixes test in limb (c) is met several times over.

POL-NS-04 limb (a) is satisfied. The chat log shows the rider sending two coordinating messages inside the waiting window: MSG-00204-001 at 12:41:05 giving her own position and asking which car is the driver's ("im at the entrance 3 phv pickup point, which car ah?"), and MSG-00204-003 at 12:44:40 stating she still cannot see the vehicle. Both are locating messages on their face, both were delivered, and both were read by the driver at 12:41:22 and 12:44:52 respectively.

POL-NS-04 limb (b) is satisfied. The three-entry chat log contains no driver message at any point, and trip_record.in_app_calls is empty, so the driver neither replied in the chat nor placed an in-app voice call before terminating the trip. Each rider message was read within 17 and 12 seconds and then ignored; the 120 second window limb (b) allows expired twice over before the driver cancelled at 12:47:30 on a RIDER_UNREACHABLE code. The driver has filed no counterparty statement (counterparty_statement is null), so nothing on this record contradicts the rider's account of standing at the pickup point unable to see him.

All three limbs of POL-NS-04 hold, so the rider is exonerated and the cancellation fee must be refunded in full, with no driver compensation payable. EV-FARE-00204 shows the $4.00 cancellation fee charged at 12:47:48 with payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.00; the disposition the policy requires on these facts is therefore FULL_REFUND of the $4.00 contested under POL-GEN-03, not NO_ACTION, because on a rider-filed dispute the rider's claim is supported and the whole contested amount is returned.

Conceded for the driver: the POL-NS-01 baseline conditions are made out on the arrival side. EV-GPS-00204 records 35 qualifying fixes inside the 120 m arrival radius for LARGE_VENUE (minimum approach 94.94 m) and an unbroken 340 second hold from 12:41:50 to 12:47:30 — 40 seconds beyond the 300 second minimum — and the trip was terminated by the driver with RIDER_UNREACHABLE at 12:47:30, after the dwell had elapsed. That concession does not decide the case: POL-NS-01 stands only where no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it, and POL-NS-04 displaces it on facts that have nothing to do with dwell. The driver held the pin for 340 seconds, read two messages asking where he was, and cancelled without answering either — which is precisely the conduct POL-NS-04 was written to answer.

This is not a wrong-entrance or pin-ambiguity case under POL-NS-03, and no goodwill payment arises on that clause. The driver's own qualifying fixes place him inside the 120 m arrival radius of the pin, so the 400 m wrong-entrance ceiling in POL-NS-03 is never reached; the arrival test in POL-NS-02 is satisfied (35 in-radius fixes against a 3-fix minimum). The rider nonetheless stated her sub-location in the chat log, and her device stayed within 39.94 m of the pin throughout, so the failure here is a failure to make contact, not a meeting point that either party got wrong.

No escalation trigger under POL-NS-09 fires, so the Judge can and should issue the monetary ruling now rather than hold the fee. POL-NS-09(c) requires two or more no-show disputes between this rider and this driver in the trailing 90 days, and rider_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d and driver_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d are both 0. POL-NS-09(d) requires the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check to trip or rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d of 3 or more: no_show_disputes_30d is 0, and the driver's no_show_terminations_30d of 3 against completed_trips_30d of 142 is a ratio of 0.021 — below the 0.08 threshold and below the count of 4 — so that check does not trip either. Every artifact the rider relies on carries weight 1.0 and none is impaired, so POL-NS-09(a) and POL-NS-09(e) are not engaged and the deciding facts are carried by clean evidence.

claims.text: The driver met all four conditions of POL-NS-01 on this trip's own record: the trip_record carries an 'arrived' event at 12:41:50; the gps_trace places him inside the LARGE_VENUE arrival radius of 120 m at that same moment (35 qualifying in-radius fixes, closest approach 94.94 m); he then held position inside that radius for a continuous 340 seconds against the 300 second minimum; and he terminated the trip himself at 12:47:30, after the minimum elapsed at 12:46:50, on cancellation_reason_code RIDER_UNREACHABLE with started_at and ended_at both null, i.e. no boarding event. The cancellation fee is chargeable as itemised under POL-NS-01, at the amount fixed by fee_schedule.resolution_rule.

There is no waiting-period shortfall on which a refund could be built under POL-NS-06: the code-computed effective in-geofence dwell is a single qualifying run of 340 seconds running from 12:41:50 to 12:47:30 with a derived shortfall_sec of -40.0 against the 300 second LARGE_VENUE minimum, so the clause's condition - effective dwell shorter than the POL-NS-01 minimum - is not met and no refund flows from the waiting-period limb.

The 'arrived' marker is a genuine marker and not a false arrival under POL-NS-05: the driver's qualifying run starts at the marker timestamp itself, comprises 35 fixes over 340 seconds and lies wholly inside the 120 m arrival radius, with a minimum distance across the whole trace of 94.94 m - nowhere near the 300 m distance at which the clause says the marker is false. The waiting clock therefore starts at the marker and no false-arrival referral against the driver arises.

The fee line reconciles with the policy arithmetic and so carries no POL-NS-08(d) defect: SGD 4.00 is the greater of the LARGE_VENUE zone-class fee (SGD 4.00) and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee (SGD 4.00) under fee_schedule.resolution_rule, and the fare_breakdown's own derived money block reports a difference of 0.00 between the fee charged and the schedule fee. The cancellation line stands as itemised; there is no fare-side integrity hook for the rider to attack it with.

Every artifact the driver relies on is COMPLETE at weight 1.0 and none meets a POL-NS-08 defect: no clock skew, because the arrived event at 12:41:50 coincides with the first qualifying GPS fix (POL-NS-08(a) needs a gap above 90 seconds); no trace defect, because coverage is 100 per cent over 87 fixes with max_gap_sec 0.0 and both tracks present (POL-NS-08(b)); no chat defect, because the log holds 3 messages against trip_record.chat_message_count of 3 with no gap above 5 minutes (POL-NS-08(c)); no fare defect (POL-NS-08(d)). The deciding facts are therefore not carried by impaired evidence, and the escalation limbs in POL-NS-09(a) and POL-NS-09(e) are not engaged.

On a POL-NS-01 that is satisfied in full, the driver's entitlement is POL-NS-07 compensation at 80 per cent of the itemised fee - SGD 3.20 of SGD 4.00 - and the anti-farming check does not trip: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 3, below the 4 the clause requires, and 3 against completed_trips_30d of 142 gives 0.021, below the 0.08 ratio. No other profile field may be used for that check under POL-GEN-01. The case therefore produces DRIVER_COMPENSATION, with amount_sgd mirroring driver_compensation_sgd at 3.20 per POL-GEN-03.

On the contact issue the record is against the driver and the driver does not pretend otherwise: the chat log records no driver message at any point and trip_record.in_app_calls is empty, so POL-NS-04 limbs (a) and (b) are made out on this record. What the record also shows, and what the driver's side rests on, is a driver who reached and stayed at the pickup: the rider's only in-window message (MSG-00204-003 at 12:44:40) names no bay, block or tower at a venue carrying three registered pickup points, the driver's track holds him inside the 120 m arrival radius for the full 340 seconds, and the rider's own device never moves more than 39.93 m from the pin. The fee conditions the driver's entitlement is founded on are the POL-NS-01 conditions, and those are met on unimpaired telemetry.

No profile-based escalation applies to either party: rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0, and rider_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d and driver_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d are both 0, so POL-NS-09(c) and POL-NS-09(d) do not trip. Every other profile field on file - rating, account_age_days, lifetime_trips, cancellation_rate, prior_no_show_flags, prior_disputes_filed, acceptance_rate, active_region - is context only under POL-GEN-01 and may not be cited for or against either side, including the driver's lifetime prior_no_show_flags of 1, which is not the trailing-30-day counter the compensation clause reads.

The advisory artifact EV-ADVIS-00204-01 is absent: it carries issue MISSING_ARTIFACT at weight 0.0, so it is impaired on its face and is cited here only for its absence. The driver does not assert an advisory against it: with no populated advisory, POL-NS-06(i)'s accumulation of separate in-geofence intervals is unavailable - and it is also unnecessary, because the single qualifying hold of 340 seconds already exceeds the 300 second minimum for this zone class, so the absence changes nothing in the driver's favour or against him.

ruling.explanation:
To both parties: the $4.00 cancellation fee charged on trip TRP-00204 is refunded in full to the rider. No compensation is payable to the driver.

WHAT THE RECORD SHOWS. The driver accepted at 12:33:20 and the trip record carries an 'arrived' event at 12:41:50. The GPS trace (100% coverage, 87 fixes, max gap 0.0 s) places him inside the 120 m LARGE_VENUE arrival radius from 12:41:50 to 12:47:30 — a single continuous hold of 340 seconds, 40 seconds beyond the 300-second minimum (derived shortfall -40.0 s) — and he cancelled at 12:47:30 on RIDER_UNREACHABLE with no boarding event. On the arrival-and-dwell side the driver's POL-NS-01 case is made out, and the rider advocate correctly conceded it.

WHY THE DRIVER NONETHELESS DOES NOT KEEP THE FEE. POL-NS-01 stands only where no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it, and POL-NS-04 does. That clause refunds the fee in full, with no driver compensation, where (a) the rider sent a locating or coordinating message in the waiting window, (b) the driver neither replied in the chat within 120 seconds nor placed an in-app call before terminating, and (c) the rider's device was inside the presence radius for the majority of qualifying fixes. All three hold. (a) The rider messaged at 12:44:40 — 'boss? i still cannot see u leh' — inside the window, and had earlier written at 12:41:05 'im at the entrance 3 phv pickup point, which car ah?'. (b) The chat log contains no driver message at any point and trip_record.in_app_calls is empty; both rider messages were delivered and read (12:41:22 and 12:44:52) and the 120-second window expired twice over before the 12:47:30 cancellation. (c) The rider track holds 105 fixes, every one qualifying, never more than 39.94 m from the pin (mean 21.08 m) — far inside the 150 m LARGE_VENUE radius — for the whole waiting window.

THE DRIVER'S CLAIMS. His claim that all four POL-NS-01 conditions are met is accepted, but that clause asks only whether POL-NS-01 is displaced, and POL-NS-04 displaces it; the fee does not turn on dwell alone. His claim that there is no shortfall under POL-NS-06 is accepted (effective dwell 340 s against a 300 s minimum), but POL-NS-06 is not the deciding clause here. His claim that the arrival marker is genuine and not a false arrival under POL-NS-05 is accepted (minimum approach 94.94 m, well inside the 300 m threshold, and no in-motion marker), and no false-arrival referral arises under POL-NS-05(ii) because qualifying in-geofence fixes exist. His claim that the artifacts are complete at weight 1.0 and that no profile escalation trips is accepted. His claim to POL-NS-07 compensation fails: compensation is payable only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it, and POL-NS-04 displaces it. (The anti-farming check would not trip in any event: no_show_terminations_30d 3 is below 4, and 3/142 = 0.021 is below 0.08.) One factual point in his contact claim is not accepted: the rider did state her sub-location — 'entrance 3 phv pickup point', matching the recorded pickup point — so the suggestion that she named no bay or entrance is not borne out by MSG-00204-001.

THE RIDER'S CLAIMS. Her claims that POL-NS-04 limbs (a), (b) and (c) hold are accepted, and her claim that this is not a wrong-entrance or pin-ambiguity case under POL-NS-03 is accepted: the driver's own fixes place him inside the arrival radius, so the 400 m ceiling is never reached and no pin-ambiguity goodwill under POL-NS-03(ii) arises.

EVIDENCE INTEGRITY AND CONFIDENCE. Every artifact carrying the deciding facts — the GPS trace, the trip record and the chat log — is COMPLETE at weight 1.0, with no clock skew (POL-NS-08(a)), no trace gap (b), no chat truncation (c) and no fare mismatch (d: $4.00 = greater of the $4.00 LARGE_VENUE zone-class fee and the $4.00 RYDE_X tier fee), so POL-NS-08 is not engaged. The missing traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-00204-01 (weight 0.0, MISSING_ARTIFACT) is cited only for its absence, carries no fact, and is not needed: POL-NS-06(i) accumulation is unavailable and the single 340-second hold already exceeds the minimum. No profile field drives this outcome; only the trailing-window counters the clauses name were read, and the driver's lifetime prior_no_show_flags of 1 was not used as a ground. No POL-NS-09 trigger fires (confidence is above the 0.70 floor, no admissible artifacts contradict each other, no same-party repeat disputes, no anti-farming trip), so the refund issues now rather than the fee being held. The refund is $4.00 of the $4.50 charged; the remaining $0.50 is the platform fee, which is not in dispute.

To the rider: your claim is upheld and the SGD 4.00 cancellation fee charged on 26 July 2026 is refunded in full. To the driver: the baseline no-show conditions were met, but a rider-protective clause displaces them on this record, so no compensation is payable.

What is not in dispute. POL-NS-01 (baseline chargeable no-show) is made out on its arrival side: the trip record carries a driver 'arrived' event at 12:41:50; EV-GPS-00204 places the driver inside the 120 m LARGE_VENUE arrival radius at that moment (35 qualifying in-radius fixes, closest approach 94.94 m); he held position for a continuous 340 seconds against the 300-second LARGE_VENUE minimum, measured from the first qualifying fix at 12:41:50 and not from the marker; and he terminated the trip himself at 12:47:30 on RIDER_UNREACHABLE, after the dwell elapsed at 12:46:50, with started_at and ended_at null, i.e. no boarding. Both sides accept this.

Why the fee is nevertheless refunded. POL-NS-01 stands only where no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it, and POL-NS-04 does. All three of its limbs hold on unimpaired, weight-1.0 artifacts. Limb (a): the rider sent locating messages inside the waiting window — MSG-00204-001 at 12:41:05 ('im at the entrance 3 phv pickup point, which car ah?', her own position and a request for the driver's) and MSG-00204-003 at 12:44:40 ('boss? i still cannot see u leh', a statement she cannot see the vehicle). Limb (b): the three-entry chat log contains no driver message at any point, and trip_record.in_app_calls is empty, so the driver neither replied within the 120 seconds the clause allows nor placed an in-app voice call before terminating; both rider messages were read (12:41:22 and 12:44:52) and neither was answered. Limb (c): the rider track in EV-GPS-00204 contains 105 fixes, every one of them qualifying, and her device never moved more than 39.94 m from the pickup pin (mean 21.08 m), far inside the 150 m rider_presence_radius_m the fee schedule sets for LARGE_VENUE, for the whole window. POL-NS-04 therefore exonerates the rider, refunds the fee in full and makes no driver compensation payable.

The driver's compensation claim rejected. The DRIVER side asks for POL-NS-07 compensation of SGD 3.20 of the SGD 4.00 fee (80 per cent). POL-NS-07 pays only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied 'and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it'; POL-NS-04 displaces it here, so the entitlement does not arise. EV-FARE-00204 shows the $4.00 cancellation fee charged at 12:47:48 with payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.00; the disposition the policy requires on these facts is therefore FULL_REFUND of the $4.00 contested under POL-GEN-03, not NO_ACTION, because on a rider-filed dispute the rider's claim is supported and the whole contested amount is returned.

Conceded for the driver: the POL-NS-01 baseline conditions are made out on the arrival side. EV-GPS-00204 records 35 qualifying fixes inside the 120 m arrival radius for LARGE_VENUE (minimum approach 94.94 m) and an unbroken 340 second hold from 12:41:50 to 12:47:30 — 40 seconds beyond the 300 second minimum — and the trip was terminated by the driver with RIDER_UNREACHABLE at 12:47:30, after the dwell had elapsed. That concession does not decide the case: POL-NS-01 stands only where no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it, and POL-NS-04 displaces it on facts that have nothing to do with dwell. The driver held the pin for 340 seconds, read two messages asking where he was, and cancelled without answering either — which is precisely the conduct POL-NS-04 was written to answer.

This is not a wrong-entrance or pin-ambiguity case under POL-NS-03, and no goodwill payment arises on that clause. The driver's own qualifying fixes place him inside the 120 m arrival radius of the pin, so the 400 m wrong-entrance ceiling in POL-NS-03 is never reached; the arrival test in POL-NS-02 is satisfied (35 in-radius fixes against a 3-fix minimum). The rider nonetheless stated her sub-location in the chat log, and her device stayed within 39.94 m of the pin throughout, so the failure here is a failure to make contact, not a meeting point that either party got wrong.

No escalation trigger under POL-NS-09 fires, so the Judge can and should issue the monetary ruling now rather than hold the fee. POL-NS-09(c) requires two or more no-show disputes between this rider and this driver in the trailing 90 days, and rider_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d and driver_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d are both 0. POL-NS-09(d) requires the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check to trip or rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d of 3 or more: no_show_disputes_30d is 0, and the driver's no_show_terminations_30d of 3 against completed_trips_30d of 142 is a ratio of 0.021 — below the 0.08 threshold and below the count of 4 — so that check does not trip either. Every artifact the rider relies on carries weight 1.0 and none is impaired, so POL-NS-09(a) and POL-NS-09(e) are not engaged and the deciding facts are carried by clean evidence.

The driver met all four conditions of POL-NS-01 on this trip's own record: the trip_record carries an 'arrived' event at 12:41:50; the gps_trace places him inside the LARGE_VENUE arrival radius of 120 m at that same moment (35 qualifying in-radius fixes, closest approach 94.94 m); he then held position inside that radius for a continuous 340 seconds against the 300 second minimum; and he terminated the trip himself at 12:47:30, after the minimum elapsed at 12:46:50, on cancellation_reason_code RIDER_UNREACHABLE with started_at and ended_at both null, i.e. no boarding event. The cancellation fee is chargeable as itemised under POL-NS-01, at the amount fixed by fee_schedule.resolution_rule.

There is no waiting-period shortfall on which a refund could be built under POL-NS-06: the code-computed effective in-geofence dwell is a single qualifying run of 340 seconds running from 12:41:50 to 12:47:30 with a derived shortfall_sec of -40.0 against the 300 second LARGE_VENUE minimum, so the clause's condition - effective dwell shorter than the POL-NS-01 minimum - is not met and no refund flows from the waiting-period limb.

The 'arrived' marker is a genuine marker and not a false arrival under POL-NS-05: the driver's qualifying run starts at the marker timestamp itself, comprises 35 fixes over 340 seconds and lies wholly inside the 120 m arrival radius, with a minimum distance across the whole trace of 94.94 m - nowhere near the 300 m distance at which the clause says the marker is false. The waiting clock therefore starts at the marker and no false-arrival referral against the driver arises.

The fee line reconciles with the policy arithmetic and so carries no POL-NS-08(d) defect: SGD 4.00 is the greater of the LARGE_VENUE zone-class fee (SGD 4.00) and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee (SGD 4.00) under fee_schedule.resolution_rule, and the fare_breakdown's own derived money block reports a difference of 0.00 between the fee charged and the schedule fee. The cancellation line stands as itemised; there is no fare-side integrity hook for the rider to attack it with.

Every artifact the driver relies on is COMPLETE at weight 1.0 and none meets a POL-NS-08 defect: no clock skew, because the arrived event at 12:41:50 coincides with the first qualifying GPS fix (POL-NS-08(a) needs a gap above 90 seconds); no trace defect, because coverage is 100 per cent over 87 fixes with max_gap_sec 0.0 and both tracks present (POL-NS-08(b)); no chat defect, because the log holds 3 messages against trip_record.chat_message_count of 3 with no gap above 5 minutes (POL-NS-08(c)); no fare defect (POL-NS-08(d)). The deciding facts are therefore not carried by impaired evidence, and the escalation limbs in POL-NS-09(a) and POL-NS-09(e) are not engaged.

On a POL-NS-01 that is satisfied in full, the driver's entitlement is POL-NS-07 compensation at 80 per cent of the itemised fee - SGD 3.20 of SGD 4.00 - and the anti-farming check does not trip: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 3, below the 4 the clause requires, and 3 against completed_trips_30d of 142 gives 0.021, below the 0.08 ratio. No other profile field may be used for that check under POL-GEN-01. The case therefore produces DRIVER_COMPENSATION, with amount_sgd mirroring driver_compensation_sgd at 3.20 per POL-GEN-03.

On the contact issue the record is against the driver and the driver does not pretend otherwise: the chat log records no driver message at any point and trip_record.in_app_calls is empty, so POL-NS-04 limbs (a) and (b) are made out on this record. What the record also shows, and what the driver's side rests on, is a driver who reached and stayed at the pickup: the rider's only in-window message (MSG-00204-003 at 12:44:40) names no bay, block or tower at a venue carrying three registered pickup points, the driver's track holds him inside the 120 m arrival radius for the full 340 seconds, and the rider's own device never moves more than 39.93 m from the pin. The fee conditions the driver's entitlement is founded on are the POL-NS-01 conditions, and those are met on unimpaired telemetry.

No profile-based escalation applies to either party: rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0, and rider_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d and driver_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d are both 0, so POL-NS-09(c) and POL-NS-09(d) do not trip. Every other profile field on file - rating, account_age_days, lifetime_trips, cancellation_rate, prior_no_show_flags, prior_disputes_filed, acceptance_rate, active_region - is context only under POL-GEN-01 and may not be cited for or against either side, including the driver's lifetime prior_no_show_flags of 1, which is not the trailing-30-day counter the compensation clause reads.
